'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[War against the Islamic State]], [[Islamic State insurgency in Puntland]]
**[[Puntland counter-terrorism operations]]
***In a dawn offensive, [[Puntland armed forces]], backed by [[American military intervention in Somalia (2007–present)|airstrikes]] from the Puntland Air Force and international allies, capture [[Miraale Valley]], the largest [[ISIS]] stronghold in [[Bari Region]] and a [[Islamic State – Somalia Province|militant hub]] for nearly a decade with water wells, cultivated land, and fortified positions. ISIS fighters retreat to Sadow, near [[Balade (Somalia)|Baalade]], where other units are stationed. [https://www.hiiraan.com/news4/2025/May/201698/puntland_forces_capture_key_isis_stronghold_in_togga_miraale.aspx (Hiiraan Online)] [https://www.garoweonline.com/en/news/somalia/soomaaliya-puntland-oo-gacanta-ku-dhigtay-xarunta-dhexe-ee-isis-ee-dooxada-miraale (Garowe Online)] [https://horseedmedia.net/somalia-puntland-forces-capture-last-isis-stronghold-in-miraale-valley-in-the-cal-miskaad-mountains/405973/ (Horseed Media)]
*[[Terrorism in Russia]]
**[[2025 Russia bridge collapses]]
***An explosion causes a bridge to collapse onto a [[passenger train]] with 379 occupants in [[Bryansk Oblast]], [[Russia]], killing at least seven and injuring 70 others, one seriously, including three children. The incident is being probed as an act of [[terrorism]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cr7zjy89304o (BBC News)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[Bulgaria and the euro]]
**Thousands protest in [[Sofia]] and other major [[Bulgaria]]n cities against [[Government of Bulgaria|government]] plans to adopt the [[euro]], demanding a [[referendum]] on the new [[currency]], ahead of expected approval to enter the [[eurozone]]. [https://apnews.com/article/bulgaria-eurozone-protests-nationalists-e8714ca044056b02c0a543f3025156a2 (AP)]
*More than 60 [[United Nations]] offices and agencies are requested to propose staff cuts of 20% by mid-June due to a funding shortfall, affecting around 14,000 positions. This includes staff from humanitarian offices, agencies supporting refugees, and other critical sectors. [https://apnews.com/article/un-budget-job-cuts-guterres-0e3e08fed833936fd41774ff9684cd85 (AP)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*Twenty-two people are killed, including athletes, coaches and officials, and several others are seriously injured in a road accident as people returned from the National Sports Festival in [[Kano State]], [[Nigeria]]. [https://www.cnn.com/2025/06/01/africa/athletes-killed-road-accident-nigeria-intl-cmd (CNN)]
*[[Landslide]]s and [[flash flooding]] triggered by days of torrential [[monsoon]] rains in northeastern [[India]] kill at least 22 people. [https://apnews.com/article/india-monsoon-floods-assam-4baee8dfd8518be63fae08cc2c2e58e0 (AP)]
*Two people are killed when a [[Beechcraft Bonanza]] aircraft crashes into a residential building in [[Korschenbroich]], [[North Rhine-Westphalia]], [[Germany]]. [https://www.ctvnews.ca/world/article/a-small-plane-crashes-into-the-terrace-of-a-house-in-germany-2-people-are-dead/ (CTV News)] [https://asn.flightsafety.org/wikibase/515786 (Aviation Safety Network)]
*Thirteen people are injured, including one critically, when a 93-year-old man falls ill and drives into a restaurant terrace in [[Narbonne]], [[Occitania (administrative region)|Occitanie]], [[France]]. [https://www.midilibre.fr/2025/05/31/on-aurait-dit-un-attentat-un-homme-de-93-ans-percute-la-terrasse-dun-restaurant-a-narbonne-13-blesses-dont-un-en-urgence-absolue-12732821.php (''Midi Libre'')]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Guatemalan Civil War]]
**A court in [[Guatemala]] convicts three men of [[crimes against humanity]] and sentences them to 40 years in prison for the rape of 36 women from the [[Achi people|Maya Achi]] [[Indigenous peoples of Guatemala|indigenous group]] during the civil war. [https://apnews.com/article/guatemala-war-crimes-indigenous-convicted-b5cc4488e1b9051ffa78358a6534f0b1 (AP)]
*[[Immigration to Greece]]
**[[Greece]] [[Ministry of Migration and Asylum|migration minister]] [[Makis Voridis]] announces the end of mass legalization programs for migrants. Migrants with rejected [[asylum claim]]s will face a minimum of two years in jail, with sentences [[Commutation (law)|commuted]] upon [[deportation]]. [https://apnews.com/article/greece-migration-europe-deportations-296dc5da631895bea339dc225df9be7a (AP)]
*Twenty-one people are hospitalized following an [[arson]] attack when a man angry at the outcome of his [[divorce]] sets fire to his clothes and a fuel container with a [[lighter]] on [[Seoul Subway Line 5]], causing more than 400 passengers to be evacuated and a temporary suspension of services. The suspect is arrested near [[Yeouinaru Station]] in [[Seoul]], [[South Korea]]. [https://en.yna.co.kr/view/AEN20250531000851315 (Yonhap News Agency)] [https://en.yna.co.kr/view/AEN20250531000852315 (Yonhap News Agency 2)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[David Seymour]] succeeds [[Winston Peters]] as [[New Zealand]]'s [[Deputy Prime Minister of New Zealand|Deputy Prime Minister]] in accordance with the coalition agreement between the [[National Party of New Zealand|National Party]], [[New Zealand First|NZ First]], and [[ACT New Zealand|ACT]]. [https://www.newstalkzb.co.nz/news/politics/david-seymour-sworn-in-as-deputy-prime-minister-succeeds-winston-peters/ (Newstalk ZB)]
*[[Josep-Lluís Serrano Pentinat]] is sworn in as the new [[Co-princes of Andorra|co-prince of Andorra]] and [[Bishop of Urgell]] after the Vatican accepts the resignation of [[Joan Enric Vives i Sicília]] for age limitation reasons. [https://elperiodic.ad/societat/josep-lluis-serrano-pentinat-pren-possessio-com-a-nou-coprincep-episcopal-dandorra/ (''El Periòdic d'Andorra'')]

'''Sports'''
*[[2024–25 UEFA Champions League]]
**In [[association football]], [[French Football Federation|French]] club [[Paris Saint-Germain]] defeats [[Italian Football Federation|Italian]] club [[Inter Milan]] 5–0 in the [[2025 UEFA Champions League Final|final]] to win its first [[UEFA Champions League]] title.
